texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 65], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "While I was dying in the delivery room, my husband was on a date."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 78], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "He told the nurse, \"I only want Irene to bear my children, not a dog like her."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 130], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I died, but then I woke up. It was the day of our engagement. My ex sneered, \"Are you so desperate for me that you’re stalking us?"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 16], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "You’re pathetic."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 45], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "His mistress Irene giggled, \"Give up, Serena."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 26], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "Xavier will only marry me."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 53], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "You’re just a supporting character in our love story."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 41], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "They had no idea I remembered everything."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 65], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "The cold hospital, my dead baby, and my parents’ fatal car crash."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 53], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I loved him with my whole heart, and he destroyed me."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 100], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "But I also remembered the secret: After I died, Xavier's terrifying uncle Timothy took his own life."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "He had thousands of photos of me."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 37], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "He had loved me in silence for years."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 72], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "When my parents asked who I wanted to marry, I didn't choose the nephew."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 69], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I looked them in the eye and said: \"I want to marry Timothy Sherwood."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 138], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "Xavier used to scream at me for spending a penny. Now, Timothy sent me an unlimited black card. \"Spend it all, darling,\" his message read."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 23], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I’m no longer a beggar."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 59], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "Irene cornered me, screaming that I was stalking \"her\" man."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 35], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I laughed and whispered: \"Keep him."}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 51], "size": 15, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [], "font": {"id": "7037018943218782757", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "I’m busy buying a dress to become your future Aunt."}
